results.note: NettyHttpProxyConnectHttp2IntegrationTest (upstream fix 40939d794, after 8.0.0): cleartext HTTP/1.1 and h2c prior knowledge inside a cleartext CONNECT tunnel. The 8.0.0 oracle assumes TLS, answers the CONNECT 200 and closes the tunnel without an answer; the fix classifies the first tunnelled bytes. Port: tests/upstream/connect_tunnel_protocols.rs The tunnelled bytes follow the CONNECT after a second (chunkMillis): the oracle opens its loopback to itself before it answers 200, and bytes that arrive while it does so are lost, so a 200 ms gap raced against a cold oracle.
